title: Aspire Gotek X3 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Aspire Gotek X3 is a compact and modern pod vape kit that blends upgraded performance with the Gotek series’ striking design. This latest version in the Gotek series features a robust 1200mAh built-in battery, almost double the capacity of the original Gotek X, providing extended use between charges without compromising portability. The Gotek X3 offers three adjustable power levels, allowing you to fine-tune your vape to suit different pod resistances or personal preference. A discreet battery level indicator is built into the side panel, showing power levels at a glance without disrupting the device’s clean aesthetic. A built-in airflow slider on the base lets you adjust between a tighter or looser MTL draw, giving you precise control over both flavour and feel. Included with the kit is a 2ml Gotek pod with a 0.6ohm (RDL/MTL) coil, ideal for nicotine salts or 50VG/50PG freebase e-liquids . The device also supports all Gotek series pods, giving you the option to switch to the original 0.8ohm (MTL) pod or other variants for an experience that perfectly aligns with your vaping preferences. With a redesigned translucent chassis and improved ergonomics, the Gotek X3 feels more comfortable in the hand than ever and looks sharp in any of its eye-catching colour options. Explore our wide range of vape juice online and pick the perfect partner for this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
